section: B36 resume board / spec 5a color scale
question: The new /questions list renders an unclassified open_question.confidence with the loud StateBadge state="unparsed" (fuchsia/hatched) treatment, but the already-shipped /questions/[id] detail view renders the same null value quietly as <Absent> with a stated reason. Spec 5a says semantic state colors "carry meaning consistently across every surface" -- should the detail view be updated to match the list's louder treatment, or should the list be softened to match the detail view, so open_question.confidence reads one way everywhere?
best_guess: Kept the list's own treatment (loud, matching DefectSeverityChip's precedent for an ungraded/unclassified enum) and left the detail view untouched rather than editing a file another unit already built and tested. Recorded the inconsistency rather than resolving it unilaterally.

question: Five existing pages (registry, work-items, waits, settings/tokens, settings/export) read their own nav metadata by POSITIONAL INDEX into OPERATOR_ROUTES (OPERATOR_ROUTES[0] through [4]) instead of looking up their own href. That made inserting /questions after /waits unsafe -- it would have silently shifted settings/tokens and settings/export to the wrong index and swapped their displayed titles, on a screen this run cannot even view to catch it (the operator session is revoked). I appended the new entry at the end of the array instead, which is safe but means the array's order no longer matches the sidebar's intended reading order for Questions. Should a follow-up unit refactor those five call sites to `OPERATOR_ROUTES.find(item => item.href === "/...")` so a future insertion can't repeat this, and should /questions then move to sit after /waits?
best_guess: Appended at the end this run (zero risk to the five existing pages) and flagged the fragile pattern rather than fixing five files outside this unit's ownership.
